whyThisCaseExists.failureBeforeTheFix: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` exited 1 with `lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen` + `skipped 1 workspace listed in bun.lock but not on disk: "@mpd-dsh/team-tools-plugin"`, so EVERY later step was unreachable. The stale entry was created by commit dc4ec92c, which renamed packages/mpd-team-tools-plugin to packages/mpd-team-core-plugin without regenerating bun.lock.
whyThisCaseExists.secondFailureClass: With the lockfile fixed, two aggregate members still cannot pass on a bare runner: `preset-conformance --self-test` exits 1 with `dsh is not on PATH — the case cannot verify the installed harness` (measured directly, see below), and `vendor` exits 1 with `upstream checkout not found`.

theRealThing.whyThisSectionExists: The rehearsal above reproduces the workflow's COMMANDS. It could not observe a LOAD-TIME rejection, and that turned out to be the actual reason CI 'does not run at all': GitHub never created a job, so there was nothing to reproduce step by step.
theRealThing.rootCause: `.github/workflows/gates.yml` carried the unquoted step name `Install the toolchain (dev dependencies: tsgo and the AST checker's typescript)`. A `: ` inside an unquoted YAML scalar starts a nested mapping, so the document was invalid and GitHub refused the whole workflow at load time. Measured signature: run conclusion=failure, duration 0 s, ZERO jobs, banner 'This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue' — on every push from 2026-09-28 through 2026-10-02 (four of them on dev/master), i.e. the lockfile and gate-member defects fixed by this PR could never have shown themselves.

theNewGate.why: an unloadable workflow disables EVERY gate in the aggregate at once, and its failure is silent (load-time, no job, no logs) — so it must redden something that runs OUTSIDE the workflow.
theNewGate.checks: real YAML parse; `name`/`on`/non-empty `jobs`; a trigger block that parsed as a boolean; every job's `runs-on` + non-empty `steps`; every step's exactly-one-of uses/run and a STRING name; a zero-subject directory is refused
theNewGate.parserSource: resolved from the installed harness (the same route preset-conformance uses for its schemas), with an MPD_WORKFLOW_JS_YAML override and the repository's own node_modules as fallbacks; no parser FAILS by name rather than skipping
theNewGate.selfTest: 7/7 arms on temp fixtures, the FIRST of which is the exact historical line and asserts the parser REJECTS it
theNewGate.aggregate: `bun run verify:gates` now reports 8/8 members green (the member table in scripts/verify-gates.ts is the one declaration point)

verdict.aggregateMembersGreen: 8/8 (was 7/7 before the workflows member was added)
verdict.notProvedHere: GitHub's runner image itself is only exercised by the two runs above, which did not cover every future push; the gate this wave adds (scripts/verify-workflows.ts) covers the load-time class, not a runner-specific failure.
